summary: Dr. Sara Labaton reflects on the legacy of her father, Rabbi Dr. Ezra Labaton, on the occasion of his ninth yahrzeit. She explores his interpersonal impact, his dedication to friendship, and his simple, steady faith in Hashem as a source of comfort.
questions: How can we honor the legacy of a loved one on their yahrzeit?
What does the biblical concept of kol demama daka teach us about interpersonal relationships?
How did Rabbi Dr. Ezra Labaton maintain his faith during illness?
What is the significance of friendship in the life of a rabbi?
